hypothesis: Use a shared nonlinear model of unconditional net payoff conditioned on market features and action parameters, and compare static vs monthly purged retraining. No Kronos dependency or forced positive trades.
policy: Use unchanged v5 geometry, expected net>=0.3%, fill>=0.25, 5-day cooldown, max4/month, baseline1x. Do not sweep thresholds or add rule-based directions.
data_rule: Fit only rows whose complete label_end precedes fit_at minus8 days, within730 days of fit_at. Monthly branch refits at UTC month start using only matured labels. All periods already development; not a new independent test.
selection: Both validation and policy positive after normal/fee/execution stress, DD<=20%, at least15 combined fills before further validation. Neither branch gets live approval from this trial. Preserve both results.
compute: Local CPU 2 threads; existing local GPU cache may continue. No new cloud job.
